mapper.select: SELECT id,order_id,notification_type,title,message,status,read_at,created_at FROM customer_notifications WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_notifications WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND status='UNREAD'
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_notifications SET status='READ',read_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND customer_id=#{customerId} AND status='UNREAD'
UPDATE customer_notifications SET status='READ',read_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND status='UNREAD'
mapper.select: SELECT id,event_id,topic,payload,status,attempts FROM notification_delivery_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW','RETRY') AND next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_delivery_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',attempts=attempts+1,published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('NEW','RETRY')
UPDATE notification_delivery_outbox SET status='RETRY',next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status='DEAD'
